CustomField.label: Price
CustomField.description: The real, editable source of truth for this product's price — read directly by ProductCatalogController (storefront display) and CheckoutController (server-side re-pricing at checkout). Synced once from the Standard Price Book's PricebookEntry.UnitPrice; PricebookEntry itself is still required by the platform (OpportunityLineItem/OrderItem both mandate a PricebookEntryId), but its UnitPrice value no longer drives what's actually charged — edit Price__c instead.
